completionAndFailureProtocol: Create new unique output directory and stage intent before one dispatch. Do not move/delete/overwrite existing results. Record shader/source/input hashes, kernel/thread groups, buffer names/count/stride and submission count.
Retain AsyncGPUReadbackRequest and per-request state until callbacks settle. Only validate actual produced data. Completion marker is written last, after output and state/resource checks.
No callback submits a next stage. No next-stage command until prior marker, every validation and disposal receipt are confirmed. A pending request is uncertain, not denied or complete.

Any device/reset/error, shader warning inconsistent with reviewed compile, resource/CPU mismatch or stalled request blocks all further GPU work. Do not extend timeout, retry, exit Play (none entered), force-dispose pending GPU resources, kill, reset or alter driver/TDR.

Release only owned buffers/shader after every associated request actually completes. If completion is unknown, retain them and report exact stage/last receipt. Never release borrowed project or product buffers.
